title: 第16章 天赋树开启第17章 召唤大师
content_zh:
第十六章 天赋树开启
黑与白的光影在空气中交叉而过，暴发出了明亮的火花。
“呜！”
罗德迅速后撤，纯白的剑刃不住的颤抖着，巨大的冲击力从剑身上传来，震的他上半身都有些隐隐作痛。
和罗德的记忆中一样，十五级的石像鬼的确不好对付，特别还是两只。唯一的好处就是这些家伙还真有点战斗智慧，虽然这要是放了在平日里那可不是什么好事，但是现在，多余的人工智慧却使它们的动作变的不那么有威胁起来。特别是之前硬吃了一击破碎之刃的石像鬼现在一看见罗德的剑上散发出白色的光芒就立刻尖叫着后退，而另外一只虽然没有受过打击，不过看同伴的动作也是犹豫不定，这也让罗德有了喘息的机会。
不过这只是暂时的。
手握星痕，望着悬浮在天上的两只石像鬼，罗德咬紧牙关。虽然说这两只石像鬼因为顾忌自己的破碎之刃不敢再强攻，不过罗德也可以肯定它们不会这么容易放过自己的。虽然现在双方还能够僵持，但是这种情况不会持续太久。在提升到八级时罗德就已经把月影剑术的熟练度D提升到了4/4，虽然在等级提升之后破碎之刃消耗的灵魂力量已经减少了一些，但是如果频繁使用的话还是会出现问题。更何况这可不是最后一战，罗德必须保留一部分力量来应对接下来很有可能出现的突**况。毕竟他是三人中唯一拥有战斗力的人，如果在这里把所有的力量都消耗光了，那么就会非常麻烦。
而这两只石像鬼也并没有和罗德一直大眼瞪小眼，相反，它们来回俯冲，伸出利爪对罗德发动袭击，一旦发现他有反击的意思就立刻离开。这种车轮式的战斗对于体力的要求相当高，不过对于两只完全由魔力驱动的人造炼金体来说，却并不是什么障碍。
但是对罗德来说就完全不同了。
汗珠缓缓的从罗德的额头浮现，他的身体已经在刚才的一次次防守中渐渐变的疲惫了起来。但是罗德却不能够退下，他知道以自己目前的能力，想要一次单挑两只石像鬼基本上不可能，所以他惟有寄希望在莉洁的身上，毕竟教堂里并没有什么特别值得防范的危险，不过…………
我好像忘了提醒他们要注意防护法阵？
不过想了一想，罗德还是耸耸肩膀，重新把注意力集中到了眼前的石像鬼上。
反正也死不了人的。
“哎呀啊！！”
伴随着一声“凄厉”的惨叫，梅斯倒在地上，整个人抽搐不停。
“我要死了！救命啊！救命啊！”
“只是电击而已！您没有死，梅斯先生。”
正在翻找被布满灰尘和蛛网所覆盖的破旧桌子上那些已经被时间侵蚀的看不出模样的杂物，莉洁一面头也不回的对梅斯随手施放了一个治愈术抚平了他的伤痛，随后便再次投入到寻找的工作之中。
虽然一般的法师在自己的房间都会施放不少防护法术来保护自己的秘密，但是这座教堂毕竟已经“年久失修”，再加上时间已经过去了很久，防护法阵的威力也减弱了七八成，不会有什么特别大的威胁。
而作为一个半天使，莉洁的抗魔力也并不算弱，因此这些已经被削弱了威力的防护法阵对她并没有起到太大的作用，那些本来在触发时会爆发出火焰和闪电的陷阱在她的手下只是闪烁了几下微弱的魔力光辉就消失不见。倒是悲剧的梅斯先生让这些陷阱找回了不少自信，毕竟他作为一个普通人没有什么抵抗力，也因此他的表现让这些防护法阵也多多少少产生了那么点威胁。

“这，这个鬼地方真是让人讨厌………”
梅斯拍打着身上的灰尘，慢慢的爬了起来，嘴里一边嘟囔着一面偷偷的观察四周。
阴暗的教堂内，只有莉洁施放的神圣光辉安静的悬浮在她的身边，照亮了这原本漆黑的世界。但是这些场面却让梅斯看的胆战心惊，在那光亮的照耀下，他可以清楚的看见地板上那些漆黑，古怪的法阵还有森森白骨。这些足以让梅斯双腿发软，更不用说墙壁上的血痕，吓的梅斯在进来的瞬间就差点拔腿逃跑。要不是莉洁表现的非常镇定让他很没面子，再加上考虑到门外还有两个更加现实的危险，恐怕胖商人早就逃跑了。
但是现在，他却不得不硬着头皮留下来，和莉洁一起翻找那个连长什么样都不知道的“控制中枢”。
这鬼地方这么杂乱，怎么能够找到那个奇怪的东西呢？
拍了拍身上的灰尘，梅斯低声的嘀咕着，但是看看莉洁认真的表情，他还是没有多说什么，继续埋头寻找了起来。
而此刻的罗德也同样不轻松。
“———！”
石像鬼尖叫着扑下，罗德身体微转，擦身而过躲开了对方的攻击，但是这一次石像鬼却并没有象之前那样一击不中便立刻离开。相反，它身形一转，粗壮的尾巴瞬间甩下！
听到从背后传来的风声，罗德内心一沉。他急忙转身，同时手中的长剑也立刻封挡在自己的身前。
罗德的反应不可谓不快，但是石像鬼的攻击却也不慢，他才刚刚转过身，就感觉到一股巨大的撞击力通过剑身传了过来，强大的力量不仅仅使罗德手中洁白的剑身变的弯曲，而将他直接打飞了出去，在地上翻滚了好几圈之后才停了下来。
“呜！”
罗德爬起身，他感觉到自己头昏脑胀，气血翻腾，甚至连半边身体都是麻麻的，险些连手中的剑都要扔丢了。他本来还想下意识的摇摇头，恢复一下神智，但是从背后传来的一个轻微的声音却是让罗德立刻紧张了起来。
“咝………”
伴随着这声似有若无的声音，一道阴冷的气息从罗德的后方浮现，而罗德则想也没有想，本能的就地一滚，这才堪堪躲开了对方的攻击，而当他抬起头来时，却发现三只幽鬼正向自己缓缓的靠近。
石像鬼刚才的那一击虽然没有给罗德造成什么伤害，但是却把他从教堂门前抽飞到了结界的边缘地区。那些幽鬼虽然碍于结界的影响，没有办法靠近教堂，但是它们并没有散去，而是在无形的屏障周围徘徊，依靠自己的本能等待着机会。
而现在，机会终于来了。
罗德当然不打算成全这些幽鬼的机会，面对着缠上来的敌人，他猛一咬牙，不得不放弃了保存实力的想法，手中长剑上骤然暴发出一道白光，飞射向前。
一道洁白的光之利刃从罗德的剑身上暴射而出，它旋转分散开来，重重的打在其中一只幽鬼的身上，撕裂了它的防护，接着罗德没有犹豫立刻飞扑上去，手中的长剑在空中划过一道完美的弧线，刺入了幽鬼的身体核心。就在那只倒霉的幽鬼惨叫着化为灰尘时，罗德已然穿过了它的身体，重新回到结界保护的范围之内。
接下来该怎么办？

就在罗德思考这个问题时，眼前出现的一行系统提示却让他一愣。
[经验点数4000/1800，可升级，可开启天赋树，等级8]
自己已经到达十级了？可是在进入迷雾废墟之前，自己不过才八级而已啊？
罗德愣了一下，这才回想起来在那之后，自己似乎的确扫到过一次经验足够升级的系统提示，只不过那个时候遭遇到石像鬼的突袭，所以他没有在意。而现在看来，在自己途中所杀的那些幽鬼的经验也已经足够自己再升一级了。这也不奇怪，毕竟这可是个五人副本，几乎所有的怪物经验都是由罗德一个人获得，再加上他的等级本来就偏低，越级杀怪还有奖励加成，因此能够到达十级也很正常———唯一奇怪的或许就是明明生活在现实的世界里，却还有经验值的存在这点吧。
不过现在不是在意这些小事的时候，罗德迅速优势的机会了。
[经验点数4000/1800，可升级，可开启天赋树，等级8]
[经验点数2200/2000，可升级，可开启天赋树，获得技能点数1，等级9]
[经验点数200/2500，可开启天赋树，获得技能点数2，等级10]
[是否开启天赋系统？]
“开启！”
没有任何犹豫，罗德迅速作出了回应，几乎在不到一秒钟的时间里，他的眼前就迅速出现了三套各不相同的天赋树状图。
在龙魂大陆中，每个职业在十级之后都拥有三种天赋选择，他们可以选择其中一种作为自己的主力，也可以选择其他天赋所附带的属性和技能来进行辅助。这种天赋属性也是依靠技能点数来获得的。这也使得玩家在一开始会比较迷茫。因为人物每升一级只能够获得一个技能点，而不要说天赋树，包括剑术，法术之类的技能熟练度提升也需要不少的技能点。这也使得玩家在初期能够分配的技能点相当有限。不过幸运的是在玩家踏入中层领域之后，他们就可以通过一种“唤醒卷轴”以及完成一些高难度的任务来获得多余的技能点提升自己的技能。
而罗德的召唤剑士也拥有三种不同的天赋路线——“召唤大师”，“灵魂使者”以及“地狱领主”。
“召唤大师”每提升一定等级就可以额外增加持有者召唤出来的精灵数量。而“灵魂使者”则走的是强化召唤精灵力量的路线。至于“地狱领主”所持有的特别力量则是持有者在杀死非人类生物之后，有一定机率可以将其转换为自己的召唤精灵，当然，转换之后限定为不死属性就是了。
可以说，三种天赋各有优劣，“召唤大师”依靠数量取胜，“灵魂使者”则注重质量，但是考虑到魔兽的稀有程度以及灵魂之核的昂贵价格，“地狱领主”也是非常不错的选择。
如果换了一般人，恐怕早就会犹豫不决，每一种都舍不得放弃，但是对于罗德而言，这并不算是什么问题，毕竟，他操纵召唤剑士这个职业已经有整整七年了，他所研究出来的所有关于召唤剑士的心得和技巧早已经被相当多的玩家奉为教科书般经典的存在。甚至在游戏中，几乎有三分之二选择召唤剑士的玩家，都是以罗德的心得技巧为标准来打造自己的人物。所以，这对于很多新人玩家来说难以取舍的问题，早在罗德看见天赋树的同时就已经决定了答案。

Chapter 16 Talent Tree Opening
Black and white light and shadow crossed in the air, bursting out with bright sparks.
"Woo!"
Rhodes retreated quickly, the pure white sword blade trembling uncontrollably, and a huge impact came from the sword, which made his upper body ache.
Just like Rhodes remembered, level 15 gargoyles were really difficult to deal with, especially two. The only good thing is that these guys really have some fighting intelligence. Although this would not be a good thing in normal times, now, the extra artificial intelligence makes their movements less threatening. In particular, the gargoyle that had taken a blow from the Broken Blade immediately screamed and retreated when it saw the white light emitting from Rhodes' sword. The other one, although it had not been hit, was still hesitant based on the actions of its companion, which also gave Rhodes a chance to breathe.
But this is only temporary.
Holding the star mark in his hand and looking at the two gargoyles suspended in the sky, Rhodes gritted his teeth. Although these two gargoyles did not dare to attack again because they were worried about their Broken Blades, Rhodes was certain that they would not let him go so easily. Although the two sides are still in a stalemate, this situation will not last long. When he reached level eight, Rhodes had already raised his Moon Shadow Swordsmanship proficiency D to 4/4. Although the soul power consumed by the Broken Blade has been reduced after the level was raised, problems will still arise if it is used frequently. What's more, this is not the last battle. Rhodes must retain part of his strength to deal with possible emergencies. After all, he is the only one among the three who has combat power. If all the power is consumed here, it will be very troublesome.
The two gargoyles did not stare at Rhodes all the time. On the contrary, they swooped back and forth, extended their claws to attack Rhodes, and left as soon as they found out that he wanted to fight back. This kind of wheel-type battle requires a lot of physical strength, but it is not an obstacle for two artificial alchemy bodies powered entirely by magic.
But it was completely different for Rhodes.
Beads of sweat slowly appeared on Rhode's forehead. His body had gradually become tired from the defenses just now. But Rhodes couldn't retreat. He knew that with his current ability, it was basically impossible to challenge two gargoyles at once, so he could only place his hope on Li Jie. After all, there was no particular danger worth guarding against in the church, but...
I seem to have forgotten to remind them to pay attention to the protective circle?
But after thinking about it, Rhodes shrugged his shoulders and focused his attention on the gargoyle in front of him again.
No one would die anyway.
"Ouch!!"
With a "shrill" scream, Mace fell to the ground, his whole body twitching.
"I'm dying! Help! Help!"
"It was just an electric shock! You are not dead, Mr. Mace."
While rummaging through the indiscernible debris that had been eroded by time on the dilapidated table covered with dust and cobwebs, Li Jie casually cast a healing spell on Mace to soothe his pain without looking back, and then devoted herself to the search again.
Although ordinary mages will cast a lot of protective spells in their rooms to protect their secrets, this church has been "in disrepair" after all. In addition, a long time has passed, and the power of the protective magic circle has also been weakened by 70 to 80%, so it does not pose any particular threat.
As a half-angel, Li Jie's resistance to magic is not too weak, so these protective magic circles that have been weakened in power do not have much effect on her. Those traps that would have erupted with flames and lightning when triggered only flickered a few weak magic powers under her hands.The brilliance disappears. It's a tragedy that Mr. Mace has regained a lot of confidence in these traps. After all, as an ordinary person, he has little resistance, so his performance makes these protective circles more or less a threat.
"This, this ghost place is really annoying..."
Mace dusted himself off and slowly climbed up, muttering while secretly observing his surroundings.
In the dark church, only the sacred light cast by Li Jie floated quietly around her, illuminating the originally dark world. But these scenes made Mace tremble with fear. Under the bright light, he could clearly see the dark, weird magic circles and the white bones on the floor. These were enough to make Metz's legs weak, not to mention the blood stains on the wall. Metz was so frightened that he almost ran away the moment he entered. If Li Jie's very calm performance hadn't made him lose face, and considering that there were two more realistic dangers outside the door, the fat businessman might have escaped long ago.
But now, he had to bite the bullet and stay, and he and Li Jie searched for the "control center" that he didn't even know what it looked like.
This ghost place is so messy, how can we find that strange thing?
After patting the dust on his body, Mace murmured in a low voice, but looking at Li Jie's serious expression, he didn't say much and continued to search.
At this moment, Rhodes was not relaxed either.
“————!”
The gargoyle screamed and jumped down. Rhodes turned slightly and passed by to avoid the opponent's attack. However, this time the gargoyle did not leave immediately after missing the attack like before. On the contrary, it turned around and dropped its thick tail instantly!
Hearing the sound of wind coming from behind, Rhodes' heart sank. He turned around hurriedly, and at the same time, the long sword in his hand was immediately blocked in front of him.
Rhodes' reaction was not unpleasant, but the Gargoyle's attack was not slow either. He had just turned around when he felt a huge impact force coming through the sword. The powerful force not only bent the white sword in Rhodes' hand, but also knocked him away. He rolled on the ground several times before stopping.
"Woo!"
Rhodes got up. He felt dizzy, his blood was boiling, and even half of his body was numb. He almost lost the sword in his hand. He originally wanted to shake his head subconsciously and regain his consciousness, but a slight voice from behind made Rhodes immediately nervous.
"His..."
Along with this vague sound, a cold breath emerged from behind Rhodes. Without thinking, Rhodes rolled on the spot instinctively and managed to avoid the opponent's attack. When he raised his head, he found three ghosts slowly approaching him.
Although the gargoyle's attack just now did not cause any damage to Rhodes, it did send him flying away from the church door to the edge of the barrier. Although those ghosts were unable to get close to the church due to the influence of the barrier, they did not disperse. Instead, they lingered around the invisible barrier, relying on their own instincts to wait for opportunities.
And now, the opportunity has finally come.
Rhodes certainly did not intend to fulfill the opportunity of these ghosts. Facing the entangled enemies, he gritted his teeth and had to give up the idea of ​​conserving his strength. A white light suddenly burst out from the long sword in his hand and flew forward.
A white blade of light shot out from Rhode's sword. It spun and dispersed, hitting one of the ghosts heavily, tearing its protection. Then Rhodes immediately swooped forward without hesitation, and the long sword in his hand drew a perfect arc in the air, piercing the core of the ghost's body. Just when the unlucky ghost screamed and turned into dust, Rhodes had already passed through its body and returned to the barrier.within the scope of protection.
What to do next?
Just when Rhodes was thinking about this problem, a line of system prompts appeared in front of him, which made him stunned.
[Experience points 4000/1800, can be upgraded, talent tree can be opened, level 8]
Have you reached level ten? But before entering the misty ruins, I was only at level eight, right?
Rhodes was stunned for a moment, and then he recalled that after that, he did seem to have scanned the system prompt that he had enough experience to upgrade. However, he was attacked by a gargoyle at that time, so he didn't pay attention. And now it seems that the experience of the ghosts he killed on his way is enough for him to level up again. This is not surprising, after all, this is a five-person dungeon, and almost all monster experience is obtained by Rhodes alone. In addition, his level is already low, and there are reward bonuses for killing monsters by leapfrogging, so it is normal to reach level ten. Perhaps the only strange thing is that even though he is living in the real world, there are still experience points.
But now is not the time to care about these trivial matters, it is time for Rhodes to take advantage quickly.
[Experience points 4000/1800, can be upgraded, talent tree can be opened, level 8]
[Experience points 2200/2000, can be upgraded, talent tree can be opened, skill point 1 obtained, level 9]
[Experience points 200/2500, you can open the talent tree, get 2 skill points, level 10]
[Do you want to enable the talent system? ]
"Turn on!"
Without any hesitation, Rhodes responded quickly. In almost less than a second, three sets of different talent tree diagrams appeared in front of his eyes.
In Dragon Soul Continent, every profession has three talent options after level ten. They can choose one of them as their main force, or they can choose the attributes and skills attached to other talents for assistance. This talent attribute is also obtained by relying on skill points. This also makes players confused at the beginning. Because a character can only gain one skill point per level, not to mention the talent tree, including swordsmanship, spells and other skill proficiency improvements, which also require a lot of skill points. This also makes the skill points that players can allocate in the early stage very limited. But fortunately, after players enter the middle level, they can obtain extra skill points to improve their skills through a kind of "awakening scroll" and completing some difficult tasks.
Rhodes' Summoning Swordsman also has three different talent routes - "Summoning Master", "Soul Messenger" and "Hell Lord".
Every time the "Summoning Master" reaches a certain level, the number of elves summoned by the holder can be increased. The "Soul Messenger" takes the route of strengthening the power of summoning spirits. As for the special power held by the "Hell Lord", after the holder kills non-human creatures, there is a certain chance that the holder can convert it into his own summoned spirit. Of course, after the conversion, it is limited to the immortal attribute.
It can be said that the three talents have their own advantages and disadvantages. "Summon Master" relies on quantity to win, and "Soul Messenger" focuses on quality. However, considering the rarity of Warcraft and the high price of soul cores, "Hell Lord" is also a very good choice.
If it were an ordinary person, I'm afraid they would have been hesitant and reluctant to give up. But for Rhodes, this is not a problem. After all, he has been operating the Summoning Swordsman profession for seven years, and all the experiences and techniques he has developed about Summoning Swordsmen have already been regarded as textbook classics by quite a few players. Even in the game, almost two-thirds of the players who choose to summon swordsmen build their own characters based on Rhodes' experience and skills. Therefore, this is a difficult choice for many new players.The answer to the question was already decided when Rhodes saw the talent tree.
